verses.arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.translation: By the mount

verses.arabic: وَكِتَٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
verses.translation: And [by] a Book inscribed[1550]
verses.footnotes: [1550]- Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.

verses.arabic: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verses.translation: In parchment spread open

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.translation: And [by] the frequented House[1551]
verses.footnotes: [1551]- The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.translation: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

verses.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.translation: And [by] the sea set on fire,[1552]
verses.footnotes: [1552]- On the Day of Resurrection. Or "the sea which has overflowed."

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

verses.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verses.translation: Of it there is no preventer.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verses.translation: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verses.translation: And the mountains will pass on, departing[1553] -
verses.footnotes: [1553]- Becoming dust and moving as clouds.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translation: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.translation: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.translation: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translation: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

verses.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translation: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.translation: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verses.translation: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.[1554] Every person, for what he earned, is retained.[1555]
verses.footnotes:
[1554]- i.e., the reward thereof.
[1555]- i.e., subject or held responsible. Literally, "a hostage."

verses.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.translation: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

segments.gloss: to reinforce, to extend, to provide, to aid

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verses.translation: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

words.gloss: They will pass to one another

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verses.translation: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
segments.gloss: to question, to ask, to inquire

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.translation: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

verses.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.translation: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translation: Indeed, we used to supplicate[1556] Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

segments.gloss: to call, to invite, to pray

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.translation: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.translation: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?[1557]
verses.footnotes: [1557]- i.e., some accident or inevitable death.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.translation: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.translation: Or do their minds[1558] command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.footnotes: [1558]- In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translation: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.translation: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.translation: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.translation: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.translation: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.translation: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
segments.gloss: to write, to prescribe, to ordain

verses.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.translation: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
segments.gloss: to intend, to desire, to want, to wish

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.translation: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verses.translation: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,[1559] they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.footnotes: [1559]- Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.translation: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translation: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment[1560] before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.footnotes: [1560]- If not in this world, in the grave.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.translation: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to stand up, to rise, to establish

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translation: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
